_comment: Freeze manifest for the selected 10k MIXED-50 KalmanNet checkpoint. Written BEFORE any official AV2 VAL read (task section 10). Checkpoint selection used INTERNAL VALIDATION ONLY.

mixed_policy.name: MIXED-50
mixed_policy.mechanism: deterministic per-segment Bernoulli(mild_probability) selects FIXED sequence or the frozen MILD temporal thinning; static assignment, no per-epoch schedule
mixed_policy.curriculum_reason: MIXED-50 already dominated the FIXED baseline on all three 2k eval conditions (section 5 stop condition)

selection_provenance.selection_rationale: MIXED-50 improved the FIXED baseline on ALL three eval conditions (fixed -1.7%, mild -2.2%, strong -3.2%), had the best fixed-dt of any variant, the lowest internal val loss (0.8245), and 0 norm-overflow events during 2k screening. Passes section 7 criteria cleanly. Not a mere average that loses on both endpoints.

dataset.note: identical dataset+split hashes as NATURAL 10k FIXED-DT and MILD variable-dt 10k baselines

optimizer_config.note: frozen, identical to NATURAL 10k and MILD variable-dt 10k baselines. Only new axis vs baseline: per-segment MIXED-50 fixed/thinned assignment.

comparison_to_other_10k_runs.finding: MIXED-50 had a rougher instability window mid-training (val_loss transiently up to 298 across epochs 9-22) than either single-policy 10k run, but never crossed the escalation thresholds (0 element-nonfinite, 0 collapse, training_unstable=false) and the selected checkpoint (epoch 8) safely predates the entire instability window.
